items.title: Amazon sets new carbon intensity goal
items.summary: Amazon has committed to cutting the intensity of the greenhouse gas emissions associated with its electricity consumption by 65 percent by 2030, compared with 2019.

items.title: WEBINAR TOMORROW: How to turn climate risk insights into adaptation action
items.summary: # WEBINAR TOMORROW: How to turn climate risk insights into adaptation action This webinar, held in partnership with SmartResilience on 19 November, will explore why and how leading organisations are moving from simply measuring risk to actively adapting in order to protect their operations, assets and supply chains.

items.title: COP31 Covered podcast: From Yerevan to Antalya, joining up nature and climate
items.summary: # COP31 Covered podcast: From Yerevan to Antalya, joining up nature and climate The eighth episode of edie’s daily COP31 Covered podcast is streaming now, featuring an exclusive interview with Jason Dozier of the High Ambition Coalition (HAC) for Nature and People on whether the world’s 30x30 target for nature is still within reach.

items.title: COP31: UK backs call for sector-specific ‘polluter pays’ levies
items.summary: # COP31: UK backs call for sector-specific ‘polluter pays’ levies The UK has backed a call to make polluting sectors contribute to adaptation and mitigation finance, while new research found that the nation is leading in global efforts to increase the amount of government-backed export finance funnelled into net-zero initiatives.

items.title: Study: Businesses struggle to prove impact of social value action
items.summary: # Study: Businesses struggle to prove impact of social value action While most companies engage in social impact initiatives, few are able to quantify and report on the impact of these investments, new research has found.
